hooks.command: s=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$s" in "" | *[!A-Za-z0-9-]*) exit 0 ;; esac; : >"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/verba-claude-edited-$s"; exit 0
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 0; h="$r/.claude/hooks/format.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; git -C "$r" diff --quiet origin/main -- .claude/hooks || exit 0; exec "$h"
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 0; h="$r/.claude/hooks/final-checks.sh"; [ -x "$h" ] || exit 0; git -C "$r" diff --quiet origin/main -- .claude/hooks || exit 0; exec "$h"
hooks.statusMessage: Building and testing what this turn touched...
